component.name: VideoComponent

Label.text: Play/Pause: pause or resume Left/Right or Rewind/Fast Forward: seek 15 seconds Back: return to guide

component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer") m.audio = m.top.findNode("audioPlayer") m.videoTrickPlayBar = m.video.trickPlayBar trickPlayBarPosition = m.videoTrickPlayBar.translation if trickPlayBarPosition <> invalid and trickPlayBarPosition.count() >= 2 m.videoTrickPlayBar.translation = [trickPlayBarPosition[0], trickPlayBarPosition[1] - 120] end if m.videoMetadataPanel = m.top.findNode("videoMetadataPanel") m.videoThumbnail = m.top.findNode("videoThumbnail") m.videoTitle = m.top.findNode("videoTitle") m.videoDescription = m.top.findNode("videoDescription") m.videoLength = m.top.findNode("videoLength") m.videoProgress = m.top.findNode("videoProgress") m.videoTime = m.top.findNode("videoTime") m.videoMetadataShowAnimation = m.top.findNode("videoMetadataShowAnimation") m.audioPanel = m.top.findNode("audioPanel") m.audioBackdrop = m.top.findNode("audioBackdrop") m.audioBackdrop.opacity = manifestOpacity("audio_backdrop_opacity", 0.25) m.audioTitle = m.top.findNode("audioTitle") m.audioThumbnail = m.top.findNode("audioThumbnail") m.audioDescription = m.top.findNode("audioDescription") m.audioLength = m.top.findNode("audioLength") m.audioState = m.top.findNode("audioState") m.audioProgress = m.top.findNode("audioProgress") m.audioTime = m.top.findNode("audioTime") m.audioVolume = m.top.findNode("audioVolume") m.statusPanel = m.top.findNode("statusPanel") m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.loadWatchdog = m.top.findNode("loadWatchdog") m.skipTimer = m.top.findNode("skipTimer") m.volumeRefreshTimer = m.top.findNode("volumeRefreshTimer") m.mediaUrlTask = m.top.findNode("mediaUrlTask") m.audioStatusTask = m.top.findNode("audioStatusTask") m.exitDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.exitDialog.title = "Return to TV Guide?" m.exitDialog.message = "The rest of this channel's playlist will not be played." m.exitDialog.buttons = [ "Continue Watching", "Return to Guide" ] m.exitDialogActive = false m.active = false m.activePlayer = "" m.resolvePending = false m.itemStarted = false m.failurePending = false m.audioVolume.text = "Volume: unavailable"
m.top.observeField("playbackRequested", "startPlayback") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.video.observeField("position", "onVideoPositionChanged") m.videoTrickPlayBar.observeField("visible", "onVideoTrickPlayBarVisibilityChanged") m.audio.observeField("state", "onAudioState") m.audio.observeField("position", "onAudioPositionChanged") m.mediaUrlTask.observeField("mediaUrl", "onMediaUrlResolved") m.mediaUrlTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onMediaUrlError") m.audioStatusTask.observeField("statusText", "onAudioStatusLoaded") m.loadWatchdog.observeField("fire", "onLoadTimeout") m.skipTimer.observeField("fire", "playNext") m.volumeRefreshTimer.observeField("fire", "refreshAudioStatus") m.exitDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onExitDialogButton") m.exitDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onExitDialogClosed") end sub
sub startPlayback() if m.top.playlist = invalid then return exitDestination = m.top.exitDestinationLabel if exitDestination = "" then exitDestination = "TV Guide" m.exitDialog.title = "Return to " + exitDestination + "?" m.exitDialog.buttons = [ "Continue Watching", "Return to " + exitDestination ] count = m.top.playlist.getChildCount() if count = 0 endPlayback("error") return end if
m.currentIndex = m.top.startIndex if m.currentIndex < 0 then m.currentIndex = 0 if m.currentIndex >= count then m.currentIndex = count - 1 m.active = true playCurrent() end sub
sub playCurrent() if not m.active then return item = m.top.playlist.getChild(m.currentIndex) if item = invalid endPlayback("finished") return end if
if item.resolveUrl <> "" m.resolvePending = true showStatus("Selecting program " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() + "...") m.mediaUrlTask.control = "stop" m.mediaUrlTask.uri = item.resolveUrl m.mediaUrlTask.control = "run" return end if startMedia(item.url, item.title, item.streamFormat, item.description, item.HDPosterUrl, item.metadataLength) end sub
sub onMediaUrlResolved(event as object) mediaUrl = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.resolvePending or mediaUrl = "" then return m.resolvePending = false item = m.top.playlist.getChild(m.currentIndex) title = m.mediaUrlTask.mediaTitle if title = "" and item <> invalid then title = item.title if title = "" then title = m.top.channelTitle + " - Program " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() description = m.mediaUrlTask.mediaDescription thumbnail = m.mediaUrlTask.mediaThumbnail length = m.mediaUrlTask.mediaLength if item <> invalid if description = "" then description = item.description if thumbnail = "" then thumbnail = item.HDPosterUrl if length < 0 then length = item.metadataLength end if startMedia(mediaUrl, title, m.mediaUrlTask.streamFormat, description, thumbnail, length) end sub
sub onMediaUrlError(event as object) message = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.resolvePending or message = "" then return m.resolvePending = false skipFailedItem(message) end sub
sub startMedia(url as string, title as string, streamFormat as string, description as string, thumbnail as string, length as integer) m.itemStarted = false m.failurePending = false content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url if isAudioUrl(url) content.title = cleanMediaTitle(title) else content.title = title end if content.streamFormat = streamFormat content.description = description content.HDPosterUrl = thumbnail content.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" m.activeContentTitle = content.title m.activeContentDescription = description m.activeContentThumbnail = thumbnail m.activeContentLength = length
showStatus("Loading " + content.title + " (" + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() + ")") if isAudioUrl(url) m.activePlayer = "audio" m.video.control = "stop" hideVideoMetadata() showAudioPanel(content.title, "Loading") m.audio.autoplayAfterSeek = true m.audio.content = content m.audio.control = "play" refreshAudioStatus() m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "start" m.top.setFocus(true) else m.activePlayer = "video" hideAudioPanel() hideVideoMetadata() m.audio.control = "stop" m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "stop" m.video.content = content m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) end if m.loadWatchdog.control = "start" end sub
function extensionFromUrl(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) extension = "" for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 character = cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "." extension = LCase(cleanUrl.mid(index)) exit for end if if character = "/" then exit for end for return extension end function
function isAudioUrl(url as string) as boolean extension = extensionFromUrl(url) return extension = "mp3" or extension = "m4a" or extension = "wav" or extension = "aac" end function
function cleanMediaTitle(title as string) as string cleanTitle = title
queryAt = instr(1, cleanTitle, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanTitle = cleanTitle.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanTitle, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanTitle = cleanTitle.left(fragmentAt - 1)
for index = len(cleanTitle) to 1 step -1 character = cleanTitle.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "/" or character = "\" cleanTitle = cleanTitle.mid(index) exit for end if end for if cleanTitle = "" then return title return cleanTitle end function
sub onVideoState(event as object) if not m.active or m.activePlayer <> "video" then return onPlayerState(event.getData(), m.video) end sub
sub onAudioState(event as object) if not m.active or m.activePlayer <> "audio" then return onPlayerState(event.getData(), m.audio) end sub
sub onPlayerState(state as string, player as object) if state = "playing" m.itemStarted = true m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" if m.activePlayer = "video" hideStatus() else hideStatus() showAudioPanel(m.activeContentTitle, "Playing") updateAudioProgress() end if else if state = "paused" and m.activePlayer = "audio" showAudioPanel(m.activeContentTitle, "Paused") updateAudioProgress() else if state = "finished" if not m.itemStarted then return m.itemStarted = false m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" playNext() else if state = "error" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" skipFailedItem(playbackErrorMessage(player)) end if end sub
sub onLoadTimeout() if not m.active then return player = activePlayerNode() if player <> invalid and player.state = "playing" then return if player <> invalid then player.control = "stop" skipFailedItem("This playlist item timed out.") end sub
sub skipFailedItem(message as string) if not m.active or m.failurePending then return m.failurePending = true if m.top.singleItem showStatus(message + " Returning to the program guide...") else showStatus(message + " Skipping to the next item...") end if m.skipTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub playNext() if not m.active then return m.skipTimer.control = "stop" m.failurePending = false if m.top.singleItem endPlayback("finished") return end if m.currentIndex++ if m.currentIndex >= m.top.playlist.getChildCount() endPlayback("finished") else playCurrent() end if end sub
function activePlayerNode() as object if m.activePlayer = "audio" then return m.audio if m.activePlayer = "video" then return m.video return invalid end function
function playbackErrorMessage(player as object) as string if player <> invalid and player.errorMsg <> invalid and player.errorMsg <> "" then return player.errorMsg + "." if player <> invalid and player.errorStr <> invalid and player.errorStr <> "" then return player.errorStr + "." return "This playlist item could not be played." end function
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.active if m.top.singleItem endPlayback("user") return true end if if not m.exitDialogActive m.exitDialogActive = true m.top.getScene().dialog = m.exitDialog end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "play" if m.audio.state = "paused" m.audio.autoplayAfterSeek = true m.audio.control = "resume" else if m.audio.state = "playing" m.audio.control = "pause" end if return true end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "rewind" return seekAudio(-15) end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "fastforward" return seekAudio(15) end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "left" return seekAudio(-15) end if if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" and key = "right" return seekAudio(15) end if return false end function
function seekAudio(offset as integer) as boolean position = m.audio.position duration = m.audio.duration if position = invalid or duration = invalid or duration <= 0 then return false
targetPosition = position + offset if targetPosition < 0 then targetPosition = 0 if targetPosition > duration then targetPosition = duration m.audio.autoplayAfterSeek = (m.audio.state = "playing") m.audio.seek = targetPosition updateAudioProgressAt(targetPosition, duration) return true end function
sub onAudioPositionChanged() if m.active and m.activePlayer = "audio" then updateAudioProgress() end sub
sub updateAudioProgress() updateAudioProgressAt(m.audio.position, m.audio.duration) end sub
sub updateAudioProgressAt(position as dynamic, duration as dynamic) if position = invalid or position < 0 then position = 0 if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 duration = m.activeContentLength if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end if
progressWidth = 0 if duration > 0 progressWidth = int(1520 * position / duration) if progressWidth < 0 then progressWidth = 0 if progressWidth > 1520 then progressWidth = 1520 end if m.audioProgress.width = progressWidth m.audioTime.text = formatTime(position) + " / " + formatTime(duration) end sub
function formatTime(value as dynamic) as string if value = invalid or value < 0 then value = 0 totalSeconds = int(value) hours = int(totalSeconds / 3600) minutes = int((totalSeconds mod 3600) / 60) seconds = totalSeconds mod 60 secondsText = seconds.toStr() if seconds < 10 then secondsText = "0" + secondsText minutesText = minutes.toStr() if hours > 0 and minutes < 10 then minutesText = "0" + minutesText if hours > 0 then return hours.toStr() + ":" + minutesText + ":" + secondsText return minutesText + ":" + secondsText end function
sub showAudioPanel(title as string, state as string) m.audioTitle.text = title m.audioBackdrop.uri = m.activeContentThumbnail m.audioBackdrop.visible = (m.activeContentThumbnail <> "") m.audioDescription.text = m.activeContentDescription m.audioThumbnail.uri = m.activeContentThumbnail m.audioThumbnail.visible = (m.activeContentThumbnail <> "") m.audioLength.text = metadataLengthText(m.activeContentLength) m.audioState.text = state + " | Track " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() m.audioPanel.visible = true end sub
sub showVideoMetadata() m.videoTitle.text = m.activeContentTitle m.videoDescription.text = m.activeContentDescription m.videoThumbnail.uri = m.activeContentThumbnail m.videoThumbnail.visible = (m.activeContentThumbnail <> "") m.videoLength.text = metadataLengthText(m.activeContentLength) updateVideoProgress() m.videoMetadataShowAnimation.control = "stop" m.videoMetadataPanel.translation = [60, 380] m.videoMetadataPanel.visible = true m.videoMetadataShowAnimation.control = "start" end sub
sub onVideoPositionChanged() if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and m.videoMetadataPanel.visible updateVideoProgress() end if end sub
sub updateVideoProgress() position = m.video.position duration = m.video.duration if position = invalid or position < 0 then position = 0 if duration = invalid or duration <= 0 duration = m.activeContentLength if duration < 0 then duration = 0 end if
progressWidth = 0 if duration > 0 progressWidth = int(1130 * position / duration) if progressWidth < 0 then progressWidth = 0 if progressWidth > 1130 then progressWidth = 1130 end if m.videoProgress.width = progressWidth m.videoTime.text = formatTime(position) + " / " + formatTime(duration) end sub
sub onVideoTrickPlayBarVisibilityChanged(event as object) if m.active and m.activePlayer = "video" and event.getData() showVideoMetadata() else hideVideoMetadata() end if end sub
sub hideVideoMetadata() m.videoMetadataShowAnimation.control = "stop" m.videoMetadataPanel.visible = false m.videoMetadataPanel.translation = [60, 380] m.videoThumbnail.uri = "" m.videoProgress.width = 0 m.videoTime.text = "0:00 / 0:00" end sub
function metadataLengthText(length as integer) as string if length < 0 then return "" return "Length: " + formatTime(length) end function
sub hideAudioPanel() m.audioPanel.visible = false m.audioBackdrop.visible = false m.audioBackdrop.uri = "" m.audioProgress.width = 0 m.audioTime.text = "0:00 / 0:00" end sub
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
sub refreshAudioStatus() if not m.active or m.activePlayer <> "audio" then return m.audioStatusTask.control = "stop" m.audioStatusTask.control = "run" end sub
sub onAudioStatusLoaded(event as object) statusText = event.getData() if statusText <> "" then m.audioVolume.text = statusText end sub
sub onExitDialogButton(event as object) choice = event.getData() m.exitDialog.close = true if choice = 1 then endPlayback("user") end sub
sub onExitDialogClosed() m.exitDialogActive = false if m.active if m.activePlayer = "video" m.video.setFocus(true) else m.top.setFocus(true) end if end if end sub
sub showStatus(message as string) m.statusLabel.text = message m.statusPanel.visible = true m.statusLabel.visible = true end sub
sub hideStatus() m.statusPanel.visible = false m.statusLabel.visible = false end sub
sub endPlayback(reason as string) m.active = false m.resolvePending = false m.itemStarted = false m.failurePending = false m.activePlayer = "" m.mediaUrlTask.control = "stop" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" m.skipTimer.control = "stop" m.volumeRefreshTimer.control = "stop" m.audioStatusTask.control = "stop" m.video.control = "stop" m.audio.control = "stop" hideAudioPanel() hideVideoMetadata() hideStatus() if m.exitDialogActive m.exitDialogActive = false m.exitDialog.close = true end if m.top.exitReason = reason m.top.playbackEnded = true end sub
